extracted.name: No Cluck, All Crunch Tenders (With King Trumpet Mushrooms) 🍄‍🟫
extracted.description: These aren’t your average tenders. They’re meatless,crispy, bold, and unapologetically satisfying. Built from simple, clean ingredients and a whole lot of heart, they’re proof that food can be healing, bold, and still hit just right!!
ingredient_lines: 2 –3 large, sliced lengthwise King trumpet mushrooms
as needed for frying Olive oil (or oil of choice)
1/2 cup (60 g) for dry batter Gluten-free flour
1/2 cup (60 g) for dry batter Chickpea flour
1 tbsp for dry batter Badia Complete Seasoning
1 tsp for dry batter Garlic powder
to taste for dry batter Salt & pepper
1/2 cup (60 g) for wet batter Gluten-free flour
1/2 cup (60 g) for wet batter Chickpea flour
1 tbsp for wet batter Badia Complete Seasoning
1 tsp for wet batter Garlic powder
to taste for wet batter Salt & pepper
1/2 cup (120ml), add more as needed Water
instruction_lines: Slice king trumpet mushrooms lengthwise into tender shapes.
Mix all dry batter ingredients in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix wet batter ingredients, adding water until thick.
Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Dredge mushroom slices in dry batter, then coat in wet batter.
Fry mushrooms until golden and crispy on both sides.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
